body:
Ships the tractable, no-login/no-network first slice of Phase 3: 3 free
cosmetics (No Hat/Blue/Red/Green) selectable per player slot on the
existing STATE_CHARACTER_SELECT screen via Up/Down, rendered as a
solid-color brim+crown using the screen's own existing draw_rect
primitive -- no new asset pipeline needed.

Wired into both of the screen's structurally-identical update/render
blocks. scripts/build.sh compiles clean (client + server + full physics
smoke test suite), headless run (SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy) starts without
crashing.

Real, named, not-yet-built: rendering the equipped hat DURING a match (only
the select screen renders it today), the IDUNA login + real unlocked-hats
half, and the new HTTP client apps/lobby would need for that.

Commit: BRAWLPIT b73b3f5 (+ 9dc5b07 doc update).

⚓ ☃
title: Free 3-hat picker on character select (WOTAN_HAT_STORE Phase 3)
